This is a '''list of staff members''' who worked on the [[Spin-off Pokémon games|spin-off game]] [[Pokémon Snap]] for the [[Nintendo 64]], per the game's [[credits]]. It was published by [[Nintendo]] and developed by [[HAL Laboratory]] and Pax Softnica.
